gaps: The generated surface covers confirmed mobile endpoints plus hand-coded link translation and expose media inspection. Higher-level watch monitoring remains a future follow-up.

novel_features.name: Mobile search counts
novel_features.description: Count matching ImmoScout24 mobile listings before paging through results.
novel_features.rationale: Uses the replayable mobile JSON endpoint rather than blocked website HTML.
novel_features.example: immoscout24-pp-cli immoscout24-mobile-search total --geocodes /de/berlin/berlin --realestatetype apartmentrent --pricetype calculatedtotalrent --json --select results.totalResults
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this first to understand query size and avoid unnecessarily paging broad searches.

novel_features.name: Listing cards from mobile JSON
novel_features.description: Fetch listing cards with IDs, titles, address snippets, prices, room counts, thumbnails, and shareable expose links.
novel_features.rationale: Replays the mobile list endpoint with bounded pagesize and agent-friendly JSON selection.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs real listing IDs and summaries to inspect or compare.

novel_features.name: Map marker paging
novel_features.description: Retrieve map markers and paging metadata for broad regional searches.
novel_features.rationale: Keeps geo overview data in structured JSON without scraping client-rendered map pages.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to estimate geographic spread and map hit counts before fetching details.

novel_features.name: Expose section inspection
novel_features.description: Inspect detailed mobile expose sections for a real listing ID.
novel_features.rationale: The mobile expose endpoint returns structured sections, contact metadata, map data, and service blocks.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this after listing search when an agent needs detail sections for one property.

novel_features.name: Expose text and media inspection
novel_features.description: Extract all expose text values plus deduplicated property image/media URLs for careful property review.
novel_features.rationale: Recursively walks the mobile expose JSON while keeping images scoped to listing media, excluding logos and service artwork.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent must inspect wording, amenities, captions, pictures, floorplans, and other media before recommending a property.

novel_features.name: ImmoScout24 link translation
novel_features.description: Convert between ImmoScout24 web links, mobile API URLs, expose IDs, and CLI commands.
novel_features.rationale: Apartment-search workflows need both directions: ingest shared links and send web links back from CLI/API searches.
novel_features.example: immoscout24-pp-cli translate-url --search-type radius --geocoordinates '50.078;8.445;8' --realestatetype apartmentrent --pricetype calculatedtotalrent --price=-2500 --numberofrooms=3- --livingspace=100- --equipment=parking --fulltext modern --json --select web_url,mobile_urls.list,cli_commands.list
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to turn a shared web link into replayable mobile API calls, or turn CLI search parameters back into links you can send.

narrative.headline: Search ImmoScout24 through the replayable mobile JSON API, not brittle blocked HTML.
narrative.value_prop: Use the mobile JSON surface behind ImmoScout24 to count searches, list fresh listing cards, retrieve map markers, and inspect expose details. The CLI keeps responses agent-friendly with JSON, selection, bounded paging, and local sync conventions.

quickstart.comment: Verify the CLI is installed without making a network call

troubleshoots.fix: Use the generated mobile API commands; do not scrape the HTML website transport.
Check that the region path starts with /de/ and that realestatetype matches one of apartmentrent, apartmentbuy, houserent, or housebuy.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when a task needs ImmoScout24 listing search, expose detail inspection, or repeatable apartment-hunt monitoring from agent workflows. Prefer it over website scraping because the mobile JSON API is replayable and structured.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to bypass paywalls, CAPTCHA, login gates, or contact restrictions.
Do not use this CLI for official business listing insertion/export workflows that require ImmoScout24 OAuth credentials.
Do not use this CLI for high-volume scraping or proxy rotation.

recipes.title: Search around Kriftel, Hattersheim, and Hofheim
recipes.command: immoscout24-pp-cli immoscout24-mobile-search list --search-type radius --geocoordinates '50.078;8.445;8' --realestatetype apartmentrent --pricetype calculatedtotalrent --price=-2500 --numberofrooms=3- --livingspace=100- --equipment=parking --fulltext modern --pagesize 20 --json --select results.resultListItems.item.id,results.resultListItems.item.title,results.resultListItems.item.attributes,results.resultListItems.item.web_url
recipes.explanation: Use this for a rental apartment search near Kriftel/Hattersheim/Hofheim with at least 3 rooms, at least 100 sqm, warm rent below 2500 EUR, and a fixed parking-space filter. Then inspect candidate exposes for kitchen layout and modern condition with: immoscout24-pp-cli expose inspect <id> --json --select web_url,text_count,image_count,texts.value,images.render_url
